candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout; payment is the slow/failing downstream, propagating 502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side latency metrics; whether payment is slow or unreachable is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout 502 correlates with a payment POST /v1/authorizations transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout and p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment path. Bounded to downstream payment latency/timeout.
